textRuns.value: Electricity data: Ember yearly electricity data (CC-BY-4.0). Emissions, population and GDP: Our World in Data CO2 dataset (CC BY).
2024 covers 194 countries and 2025 only 94. Ember's latest years are estimates and are not flagged per value.
A missing source row means zero generation for that source (checked: the sources still add up to Ember's published total).
Shares are shares of GENERATION, not consumption; a net importer's consumption mix differs.
Power-sector emissions (Ember) are lifecycle figures; national CO2 (OWID) is territorial combustion and industry. They are not comparable.
Capacity is nameplate; capacity factors for capacities under 0.15 GW are hidden because Ember reports placeholder values there.
GDP (OWID, 2011 international dollars) ends in 2022, so the transition window is 2010-2022.
Ranking countries by share-of-generation gain rewards grids whose total generation fell; use the absolute TWh columns beside it.
Decoupled = GDP up and CO2 down over the window: an association, not evidence of cause.
Country slicers also list regions (World, EU, ...). Regions only have data on the World overview page.
